name: jaxfdm_arch_reaction_0p8
description: A 10-segment planar arch (11 nodes, 2 supports) under uniform vertical nodal loads. The original example steers the support reaction directions to [+-1, 0, -0.8] (one of six variants swept in the script).

original_run.notes: SquaredError(NodeResidualDirectionGoal at both supports, target direction [+-1,0,-0.8]); parameters: all edge force densities, no bounds.

position_fit_run.optimizer: jax_fdm.optimization.LBFGSB (scipy.optimize.minimize method='L-BFGS-B', tol=1e-10 -> ftol=gtol=1e-10, maxiter=1000, maxfun/maxls/maxcor = scipy defaults 15000/20/10, jac from jax.value_and_grad, jit)
position_fit_run.message: CONVERGENCE: NORM OF PROJECTED GRADIENT <= PGTOL
position_fit_run.notes: NodePointGoal on every free node (weight 1) with SquaredError -> loss = sum of squared distances to `target`; final_err = sqrt(loss) recomputed with an independent NumPy FDM solve at q_final. loss_trace[k] is the loss at the k-th SciPy callback (index 0 = q0). time_s includes the JIT compile/warm-up done by Optimizer.problem(); time_s_excl_jit is the SciPy solve only.

seed_sweep.q0: uniform sign * 33.74999273 (10 x median|q_ref|, clipped to bounds)
seed_sweep.message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

seed_sweep.q0: uniform sign * 0.3374999273 (0.1 x median|q_ref|, clipped to bounds)
seed_sweep.message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

caveats: The optimum of the original problem is a uniform q (a parabolic arch), so the median-seeded position fit starts at the exact solution (0 iterations); only the seed sweep is informative.
